Ava: Ugh, pouring here. Need fresh coding soundtracks + something cozy to watch later. Drop 1 album/playlist + 1 comfort movie/TV/book. Vote with :headphones: for music, :popcorn: for movie, :book: for book

Kai: For focus — 'Trailer Park' lo-fi mix (https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1). For later: Amélie or The Grand Budapest Hotel. Cozy and colorful. :popcorn:

Morgan: Max Richter's Recomposed on loop for me. If you want musical vibe + feel-good, watch Sing Street. :headphones::sparkles:

jen: Book vote — The Night Watchman by Louise Erdrich. Rainy evenings + slow tea = perfect. :book:

Ravi: For deep debugging I do Nils Frahm (Felt) then switch to Only Murders in the Building for a light watch. :headphones::popcorn:

playlist-bot: Generated playlist 'Redwood Rainy Day Coding' -> https://open.spotify.com/playlist/abcd1234 :headphones:

jen: maybe — dinner timing TBD :shrug:
